tools.name: postalform.list_forms
tools.title: List available forms
tools.description: Use this when you need the published single-mailpiece PostalForm workflow catalog available to agents. Coordinated statutory multi-recipient workflows are excluded.

tools.name: postalform.get_form_schema
tools.title: Get form schema
tools.description: Use this when you need a machine-usable schema for one supported single-mailpiece PostalForm workflow (fields, groups, attachments, and dependencies).

tools.name: postalform.search_addresses
tools.title: Search mailing addresses
tools.description: Use this to search for a mailing address and return Loqate suggestions with IDs. Pass country_code to filter by country; it defaults to US. If a suggestion has type "Container" (building/complex), call this tool again with container=<id> and a refined query to drill down to type "Address". Only type "Address" is valid for order creation.

target.description: Which address field is being searched (used for UI context).

query.description: Partial address text, e.g. "123 Main St"

country_code.description: Two-letter country code to filter suggestions. Defaults to US.

container.description: Loqate container id for drilling into suggestions, if provided

tools.name: postalform.create_pdf_upload
tools.title: Create a PDF upload
tools.description: Use this when the host cannot provide a PDF file param directly. It creates a short-lived PDF upload URL and upload token (multipart/form-data, file field). Let the HTTP client generate Content-Type with its multipart boundary.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse the same value if retrying the call.

tools.name: postalform.create_order_draft
tools.title: Create a mail order draft
tools.description: Prepare an existing PDF for mailing and return the order ID, total, hosted checkout URL, and checkout session. After buyer approval, a compatible client can pass a Stripe shared payment token to complete_checkout; otherwise present the hosted checkout URL. For direct MPP or x402 payments, use postalform.create_machine_order.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse the same value if retrying the call.

pdf.description: The PDF to mail. Prefer ChatGPT attachments ({ download_url, file_id }). Fallbacks: upload_token from postalform.create_pdf_upload, data:application/pdf;base64,..., or an https URL hosted on an allowlisted domain.

sender_address_id.description: Loqate address id for the sender (required when sender_address_type is Address).

sender_address_type.description: Address suggestion type for the sender (from postalform.search_addresses). Use Manual to pass a structured address with countryCode when outside the US.

sender_address_text.description: Human-readable sender address preview (required when sender_address_type is Address; optional for Manual).

sender_address_manual.description: Sender manual address fields (required when sender_address_type is Manual).

recipient_address_id.description: Loqate address id for the recipient (required when recipient_address_type is Address).

recipient_address_type.description: Address suggestion type for the recipient (from postalform.search_addresses). Use Manual to pass a structured address with countryCode when outside the US.

recipient_address_text.description: Human-readable recipient address preview (required when recipient_address_type is Address; optional for Manual).

recipient_address_manual.description: Recipient manual address fields (required when recipient_address_type is Manual).

color.description: Whether to print in color (default: false).

certified.description: Whether to add proof mail: USPS Certified Mail for US destinations, Canada Post Registered Mail through PostGrid for Canadian destinations, or PinGen registered mail for supported European destinations (default: false).

certified_return_receipt.description: Add Electronic Return Receipt for US Certified Mail. Ignored for Canada Post Registered Mail and PinGen registered-mail destinations (default: false).

tools.name: postalform.preview_letter_order_draft
tools.title: Preview a mail order draft from letter text
tools.description: Use this to prepare a non-writing preview for a mailed letter before creating checkout. It renders the letter, validates the addresses, and returns a widget with a create-draft action.

tools.name: postalform.create_letter_order_draft
tools.title: Create a mail order draft from letter text
tools.description: Prepare letter text for mailing and return the order ID, total, hosted checkout URL, and checkout session. Letter drafts may include typed or drawn signatures. After buyer approval, a compatible client can use complete_checkout with a Stripe shared payment token; otherwise present the hosted checkout URL. For direct MPP or x402 payments, use postalform.create_machine_order.

tools.name: postalform.create_form_order_draft
tools.title: Create a mail order draft from a workflow form submission
tools.description: Prepare a supported workflow form for mailing and return the order ID, total, hosted checkout URL, and checkout session. After buyer approval, a compatible client can use complete_checkout with a Stripe shared payment token; otherwise present the hosted checkout URL. For direct MPP or x402 payments, use postalform.create_machine_order.

use_workflow_recipient.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Predefined and computed workflow recipients are always enforced and cannot be overridden.

tools.name: postalform.create_machine_order
tools.title: Create or pay a machine order
tools.description: Create an order from a PDF, letter, or workflow form and pay through an MPP or x402 challenge after buyer approval. Use this when the client can answer those challenges through Link CLI/Link MCP or an x402 wallet. Clients with a Stripe shared payment token can instead use a draft tool followed by complete_checkout; other clients should present the hosted checkout URL.

payment_protocol.description: Direct machine payment protocol. Use mpp for Link CLI/Link MCP or Stripe SPT; use x402 for x402 wallet clients. Defaults to mpp.

request_id.description: Idempotency key. Reuse the same value and same order fields after a payment challenge.

pdf.description: Existing PDF to mail. Provide exactly one of pdf, letter, or form. Prefer upload_token from postalform.create_pdf_upload.

letter.description: Letter text to render and mail. Provide exactly one of pdf, letter, or form. Optional format may be text, html, markdown, or rtf; default is text. Optional signature may be a typed string or drawn signature payload.

form.description: Workflow form payload from postalform.get_form_schema. Provide exactly one of pdf, letter, or form.

payment_authorization.description: MPP retry value after paying with Link CLI/Link MCP. Pass the full Authorization header value, usually "Payment ...".

payment_signature.description: x402 retry value after paying the PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.title: Pay a prepared checkout
tools.description: After the buyer approves the prepared order and total, pay its existing checkout session using a compatible Stripe payment token, including a shared payment token (spt_...). Pass the order ID as checkout_session_id; do not resend the document or addresses. On an interrupted request, retry the same checkout and token. Existing authorized, processing, or paid payments are reused; follow the returned status and messages.

checkout_session_id.description: The checkout session id to finalize.

buyer.description: Buyer identity details for the approved checkout.

payment_data.description: Buyer-authorized payment token details. Use provider=stripe.

tools.name: postalform.get_order_status
tools.title: Get order status
tools.description: Read payment, processing, stored mailing/carrier status, the latest 50 public tracking events, and electronic return receipt availability. Missing carrier evidence is null; processing or a tracking number alone does not prove mailing or delivery. This read does not pay, mail, or acquire receipts.

tools.name: postalform.ping
tools.title: Ping PostalForm
tools.description: Use this when you want a quick health check that the PostalForm MCP server is reachable.
